buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Name of Work: Providing & supplying of 4 nos. vehicles (01 Innova or Equivalent 4x4 model, and 03 nos. Scorpio or equivalent) on monthly basis for Project Monito r Unit- Tura of NHIDCL & its Site Office, Rongjeng in the state of Meghalaya. 1. The vehicle will be provided along with driver. The vehicle should be preferably new or n ot more than 03 years old and not driven more than 30,000 Kms. 2. The vehicles provided should be in good running condition with clean interior & exterior an d good upholstery. Vehicle’s tyre including spare tyre should be in good condition with good fr eed depth. 3. The vehicle provided should possess valid Registration documents, with all India permit an d permission to run in other North Eastern States. 4. All necessary taxes for operating the vehicles commercially should be fully paid and all ne cessary papers shall be provided in the vehicles as required by prevailing Motor Vehicles Act with comprehensive insurance cover for the vehicles. 5. The vehicles with the Driver shall be available all time 6 days a week and shall be require d to provide service during Sundays / Holidays in case of site visit / emergency. 6. A log book shall be maintained in the prescribed format of the buyer. 7. The driver should possess a valid driving license issued by RTO and shall have zero accid ent record. Also, the drivers should wear uniform during the duty hours. Drivers police verificati on report shall be submitted before assigning after Contract signing. 8. The bidder must also ensure that all the necessary documents (registration certificate, In surance paper, PUC certificate etc.) are available with the driver deployed for duty for the de partment. 9. No mileage will be allowed or included for drivers coming from their respective places. Mi leage shall be considered from the time, the officer/individual gets in the vehicle to the time the officer /individual leaves the vehicle.

10. The bidders are required to upload with the bid, scanned copy of RC of the vehicles which are proposed to be provided to the office or self-declaration/undertaking for providing ne w vehicle. 11. The vehicle and driver will not be changed for the entire agreement period unless agreed to by the Agency or asked to be changed by the Agency due to poor/bad performance of the dri vers. The drivers shall be responsible for preparing vehicle log sheets on daily basis. 12. The vendor shall bear all expenses required for keeping the vehicles in smooth running c ondition such as fuel, lubrications oil and other consumables, necessary service and mainten ance, repairs and replacement etc. and shall bear all expenses required for keeping the driver s uch as: a) Lodging & salary of the driver per month as per Govt. norms. b) In the event of vehicle is not available for any reason, the vendor shall provide sub stitute vehicle of similar type immediately. If the substitute vehicle is not provided, hiring cost of similar vehicle, under intimation to vendor, from market will be recov ered for the duration by the Agency and the amount will be adjusted in the bills of t he vendor. 13. A fixed payment per month as per the details mentioned in the Tender Documents will b e made up to 3000 Km per month per vehicle considering availability for 30/31 day (For Februa ry 28/29 days). Extra Kilometer run will be paid when the total cumulative kilometer run for all t he vehicles exceeds 12000 kms for combined all vehicle & shall be paid @Rs. 12/- extra kilomet er. 14. The quoted rates shall be inclusive of GST and other taxes for operating the vehicle. 15. Vehicle can be withdrawn from usage with 01 (One) month of advance notice by either p arty i.e Agency or the Vendor. 16. The quoted rates for hiring charges of vehicles including fuel and lubricants, maintenanc e of vehicle etc. will be valid for period of two years from the day of acceptance and further ext endable to one year with the same terms and conditions subject to satisfactory performance. N o variation/revision in quoted rates on any account will be entertained. 17. The vendor should supply the vehicles within 7 (seven) days from the date of the agreem ent at the Agency’s office. 18. As per requirement by this office, if one or more vehicles need to be hired, same may be provided by vendor as per quoted rate for that category of vehicle. 19. All claim related to accident/damage/compensation shall be responsibility of the vendor. 20. The vendor has to furnish the performance security for an amount 3% of the contract val ue in the form of FD of any Nationalized bank within 7 days of issuance of Letter of Award. EMD of successful Bidder will be returned after receipt of performance security. The performance Se curity will be deposited in the Agency Bank Account till successful completion of the Contract

as per the agreed contract terms and conditions. Agreement shall be signed within 7 days of submission of performance security. 21. The vehicle hiring payments will be cleared every month within 10 days after submission of bill. However, in unseen circumstances, if payment is not made in time the Agency shall not pay any interest on late payment. 22. During bid submission, the bidders shall submit a copy of the following documents for ea ch vehicle to be supplied. The original documents should be available all the time in the vehicle under the custody of concerned driver. All instructions of Government need to be followed for a ll vehicles. (i) Comprehensive Accident and workman Compensatory insurance policy c overage in respect of every employee employed by Contractor and third-p arty liability as our rule valid for entire period of the contract. (ii) Copy of RC Book/Registration of Vehicle. (iii) Pollution Clearance Certificate. (iv) Driving License of concerned driver. (v) Latest Fitness certificate issued from Automobile/Mechanics. (vi) Any other documents/permit required by Govt. of Meghalaya for vehicle. OR Self-declaration/undertaking for providing new vehicles. 23. The Agency/ Authority will pay Rs.500 for outstation visit (night stay required) charges to the vendor which may be claimed by the vendor in monthly bill. Any other expenditure incurre d /demand by the driver will be settled by the vendor only. Any outstation expenditure given b y agency, over and above Rs. 500 incurred by the driver and claimed from the vendor but not paid by the vendor may be settled from the subsequent bill given by the vendor. 24. In the event any vehicles being off the road for maintenance or on any account of breakd own, the agency shall provide a substitute vehicle of same type immediately. If the substitute v ehicle is not provided, NHIDCL reserves the right to hire a vehicle from the other sources, unde r intimation to vendor & may deduct the same charges from the monthly bill of supplier subject to maximum limit of Rs.2,500/- per day. If the vehicle is not provided continuously for 07 days, the Agency reserves the right to terminate the contract immediately. Upon termination contrac t on account of failure of the vendor due to any reasons, the vendor shall be debarred from part icipation in the future bidding process for a period of 2 years in the future bids floated by NHID CL. 25. The EMD/Performance Security will be forfeited: (a) If the Bidder withdraws the Bid after Bid submission. (b) If the Successful bidder fails to submit Performance Security. (c) If the Successful bidder fails to sign the Agreement.
